Return on equity (ROE)
Formula: net profit ÷ average equity attributable to parent

Inputs
  Net profit attributable to parent (LKR)               1,200
  Equity attributable to parent, end of period (LKR)    11,000
  Equity attributable to parent, start of period (LKR)  9,000

Steps
  average equity = (9,000 + 11,000) ÷ 2 = 10,000
  ROE = 1,200 ÷ 10,000 = 12.00%

Result: 12.00%

For information only, not investment advice.
